head: 319 Chrome extensions secretly rerouted people's searches
dek: Researchers at Socket found 319 Chrome extensions, installed 13.4 million times, that changed the default search engine and sent searches through their own servers.
details: The operators earned ad money from the searches and could send them anywhere, including phishing pages. Most of the extensions have been pulled; many were unlisted on the Chrome Web Store and pushed through ads. One named example is Predator Search.
means: If your searches suddenly open on an unfamiliar site or a different search engine, an extension may be behind it.
todo: In Chrome, open the three-dot menu, then Extensions, then Manage Extensions, and remove anything you don't know or don't use. Don't install extensions from ads or other websites.
